Glavna slika sajta White Homes: Main image of White Homes website
White Homes je savremena web platforma z: White Homes is a modern web platform for listing and searching real estate. Users can create accounts, add their properties, use detailed filters, and track statistics through a personal dashboard. The platform focuses on a simple user experience and enables fast and efficient property searches.
Izrada veb dizajna i model baze podataka: Web Design and Database Model Creation
Dizajniran UI u Figma alatu uz definisan: Designed the UI in Figma, defining the basic layout and user experience. Simultaneously, an initial database model was created, focusing on listings, users, and categories.
Implementacija dizajna koristeći Next.js: Implemented the design using Next.js and TailwindCSS. Special focus was on responsiveness, fast content display, and a simple user interface.
Razvijen backend u Node.js sa MongoDB ba: Developed backend in Node.js with MongoDB. Implemented authentication (JWT), REST API, user and listing management logic, filtering, search, and notifications.
Bookiraj.me je moderna platforma za reze: Bookiraj.me is a modern accommodation booking platform in Montenegro. Users can search for apartments, hotels, and holiday homes, filter offers by price, location, and amenities, and book directly online. Property owners have their own panel to manage availability, prices, and reservations.
Napravljen detaljan UX flow za korisnike: Created detailed UX flows for users and property owners. Designed a responsive interface focused on clarity and converting visitors into users.
Frontend u Next.js i TailwindCSS, backen: Frontend developed with Next.js and TailwindCSS, backend with Node.js and MongoDB. Integrated search functionality, booking engine, calendar management, and payment system integration (Stripe, PayPal).
Povezivanje sa SEO alatima, CDN optimiza: Connected with SEO tools, CDN optimization, performance testing, onboarding property owners, and initial marketing. Admin panel with analytics and user management.
Bookiraj.me je lansiran sa više od 180 r: Bookiraj.me launched with over 180 registered properties and hundreds of bookings in the first weeks. Owners highlighted the efficient calendar system and direct payment option. The platform continues to grow through partnerships with travel agencies.
Spectre Rentals je moderna rent-a-car we: Spectre Rentals is a modern rent-a-car web platform that allows users to book vehicles online in real time. Clients can view available vehicles, filter by type, price, and location, while administrators have a detailed backend for managing fleet, pricing, and schedules.
Kreirani korisnički tokovi za turiste i: Created user flows for tourists and local users, focusing on easy booking and clear cost display. UI design adapted for mobile devices with simple booking steps.
Korišćen Next.js i Tailwind za frontend,: Used Next.js and Tailwind for frontend, Node.js for backend, MongoDB database. Implemented booking engine, daily price calculation, additional options (insurance, extra equipment), and automatic reservation confirmation. Email and SMS notifications for users.
Testiran kompletan tok rezervacije, doda: Tested the full booking flow, added multi-language and currency support, integrated Google Maps API for pick-up and return locations. Deployed on Vercel with CDN caching.
Spectre Rentals je lansiran kao jedna od: Spectre Rentals launched as one of the most advanced rent-a-car platforms in the region. Over 150 bookings were recorded in the first weeks. Clients are particularly satisfied with price transparency and multiple pick-up locations.
Glavna slika sajta Auto škole Mirav: Main image of Mirav Driving School website
Auto škola Mirav je kompletna web platfo: Mirav Driving School is a complete web platform designed to digitalize the training process for driving license candidates. The system allows online user registration, course enrollment, online tests for theoretical exam, and progress tracking via personal panels. A CMS is implemented for managing lessons, lectures, instructors, and driving schedules.
Kreirani su detaljni UI dizajn i korisni: Created detailed UI designs and user flows, including wireframes and prototypes. Simultaneously, the database information model was defined, with entities for users, tests, enrollments, lessons, materials, and schedules.
Razvijen je frontend koristeći Vue.js i: Frontend developed using Vue.js and TailwindCSS, focusing on responsiveness and user experience. Interactive components for online tests, course registration, material review, and user profile management were created.
Implementirana je serverska logika u Lar: Implemented server logic in Laravel, including authentication, database management, attendance tracking, CMS for content management, and notifications for schedules and enrollment status.
Auto škola Mirav je lansiraa kao jedna o: Mirav Driving School was launched as one of the most advanced educational applications. Students particularly appreciate the intuitive design, access to materials, and the ability to test knowledge on the platform.
Double L Centar je moderna platforma za: Double L Center is a modern platform for language courses and translation services. Students can book lessons, register for exams, and participate in online classes. Clients can quickly order translations, upload documents, and receive automatic price estimates.
Analiza potreba škole, dizajn korisnički: Analyzed school needs and designed user scenarios for teachers, students, and translation services. Special focus was on simple management of bookings and documents.
Integracija rezervacija časova sa Google: Integrated lesson bookings with Google Calendar API, developed user dashboard, CMS for courses, and translation module with automatic price calculation based on language, translation type, and text length.
Uvođenje sigurnosnih mjera za upload faj: Implemented file upload security measures, performance optimization, multi-language support, and staff training for using the admin panel.
Zakažite čas ili naručite prevod: Schedule a Lesson or Order a Translation
Double L Centar sada ima jedinstveno rje: Double L Center now has a unified solution for all its services — over 300 students completed courses in the first three months, and the translation ordering system has significantly sped up daily processes.
Meddis Nekretnine je savremena platforma: Meddis Real Estate is a modern platform for presenting and searching properties. It allows users to quickly find apartments, houses, and commercial spaces by location, price, and other filters, while the admin can easily manage listings through a simple CMS.
Analiza tržišta nekretnina, definisanje: Analyzed the real estate market, defined user personas, and planned UX to facilitate quick filtering and browsing of listings.
Dizajniran je moderan interfejs sa mapam: Designed a modern interface with maps, galleries, and quick filtering options. Backend allows easy content management and automatic generation of SEO-friendly URLs.
Testirani su svi filteri i kontakt forme: Tested all filters and contact forms, optimized site performance for fast loading on mobile and desktop.
Meddis platforma je postala centralna ta: The Meddis platform has become the central point of the agency's online presence. Over 150 properties were actively listed in the first month, with an increased number of direct inquiries through the site.
Frontend prikaz povezan sa Directus API-: Frontend Display Connected to Directus API
Naš tim je učestvovao u razvoju i unapre: Our team participated in the development and enhancement of the open-source Directus project. We focused on developing additional features, improving the user interface, and contributing to the shared code via official pull requests.
Razvijene su custom ekstenzije i API end: Developed custom extensions and API endpoints enabling specific client requirements and integration with external systems.
Redizajn interfejsa za jednostavniju nav: Redesigned the interface for easier navigation and better data visibility, including tables, forms, and filters.
Kreirana detaljna dokumentacija za nove: Created detailed documentation for new modules and tested all functionalities to ensure stability and compatibility with future Directus versions.

Kreiramo jasan plan sajta i arhitekturu:

We develop a modern, responsive design for all screen sizes.
Next, we move to the technical part – website programming.

Nakon lansiranja ostajemo uz vas.\nNudim:
After launch, we stay with you.

Pružamo kompletna digitalna rješenja. Na: We provide complete digital solutions. Our team combines experience, creativity, and technical expertise to turn your vision into a functional and reliable website. We are committed to quality, meeting deadlines, and a personalized approach for each client.
Svaki projekat posmatramo kao jedinstven: We view each project as a unique story. We tailor design and functionality to your specific needs, following your business information flow. We offer only solutions that work for you and build a web presence that delivers real and measurable results.
Šta je to domen?: Your domain is your address on the Internet. A domain name is very important and should be smartly chosen, simple, and easy to remember.
Šta je \"Hosting\"?: To have a website on the internet, you need either your own web server or a web hosting provider. Web hosting is essentially the space where your website's data is stored online. A web host is the host where all your site’s data resides.
Šta mi je potrebno da bih započeo izradu: You need information such as your company logo, company description (since when it exists, number of employees), services provided, types of products sold or produced, contact information (phone, fax, email, company address, photo of your premises, map of location).
Da li su mogući zlonamjerni napadi haker: Hacker attacks are more common than you might think. Our team has the necessary expertise to secure and protect your digital infrastructure.
Kako radimo?: Our approach is based on analysis, planning, design, and implementation. Each project starts with detailed planning, competitor research, and client needs. Then we move to website or application design and coding, testing, and final implementation.
Koje tehnologije koristimo?: We work with modern web technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Next.js, PHP, WordPress, and others as needed. We also integrate databases and APIs according to client requirements.
Koliko traje izrada sajta?: Development time depends on project complexity. Smaller websites can be completed in a few weeks, while complex applications may take several months. We always provide a realistic timeframe at the start.
Da li pružate podršku nakon izrade sajta: Yes, we offer different support packages including content updates, technical support, backups, and optimization. Our goal is to keep your site functional and up-to-date.
Koja je cena izrade sajta?: The price depends on project scope, design complexity, and desired features. Each project is evaluated individually and we prepare a transparent and tailored offer.
